mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and subsequently drives up the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which in turn drives down the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to decreased consumer spending and subsequently drives down the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of rising unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher demand for raw materials and subsequently drives up the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase and GDP growth rate is strong, it signals a growing economy with high consumer spending, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of strong housing starts and GDP growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is low and the CPI is rising, it signals an inflationary environment, leading to decreased purchasing power and subsequently driving down the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of low federal funds rate and rising CPI (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment increases and the unemployment rate is low, it signals a strong labor market, leading to increased consumer spending and subsequently driving up the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales increase and GDP growth rate is strong, it signals a growing economy with high consumer spending, leading to higher S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of strong retail sales growth and GDP growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
